id.title: Merchant identifier
id.description: This field contains the identifier of the merchant created.

document_number.title: Document number
document_number.description: This field contains the document number of the merchant created.

brand_name.title: Brand name
brand_name.description: This field contains the brand name of the merchant created.

name.title: Merchant name
name.description: This field contains the name of the merchant created.

creditor_id.title: Creditor identifier
creditor_id.description: This field identifies the creditor related to merchant created.

program_id.title: Program identifier
program_id.description: This field identifies program in which the merchant was registered in.

account_id.title: Account identifier
account_id.description: This field identifies account related to the merchant created.

external_id.title: External merchant identifier
external_id.description: This field contains the identifier provided by an external system for the the merchant.

external_code.title: Business category external code
external_code.description: This field contains the external code for the merchant business category.

status.title: Status
status.description: This field contains the current merchant status.

address.title: Address
address.description: This field contains the address of the merchant.

number.title: Number
number.description: This field contains number that composes the address.

complementary_address.title: Complementary address
complementary_address.description: This field contains information that complements the address.

neighborhood.title: Neighborhood
neighborhood.description: This field contains the name of the neighborhood.

zip_code.title: Zip code
zip_code.description: This field contains the zip code of the merchant's address.

city.title: City
city.description: This field contains the city where the merchant is located.

state.title: State
state.description: This field contains the state where the merchant's city is located.

country.title: Country
country.description: This field contains the merchant country.

city_code.title: City code
city_code.description: This field contains the national code that identifies a city.

contact.title: Contact name
contact.description: This field contains the merchant contact name.

area_code.title: Area code
area_code.description: The area code of the merchant phone.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: This field contains merchant phone number.

additional_area_code.title: Additional area code
additional_area_code.description: This field contains area code for an additional phone number.

additional_phone.title: Additional phone
additional_phone.description: This field contains an additional phone number.

email.title: E-mail
email.description: This field contains the merchant e-mail address.
